host:current_contract_code.disagreement_reason: on an account whose contract is global (AccountContract::Global / GlobalByAccount) nearcore returns 2 / 3 with the code hash / the account id (logic.rs:4000-4030); Lean always returns 1 with the code hash (Wasm/Host.lean:726-730, ctx.accountContract := some hash in Successor/StorageExecution.lean:202), so the post-state differs and Lean rejects the valid chunk. Not a soundness bug: no Lean accept of a nearcore reject
